deadline.value: Fall priority deadline for PhD financial aid consideration is December 31, 2026 (final Fall deadline May 1, 2027 per CCNY).
deadline.quote: The ChE Ph.D program priority deadline for Fall: December 31st.

also.quote: Fall- December 31st (PhD Financial Aid priority) | Fall - May 1st

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is no longer required for admission to the Chemical Engineering PhD program.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required for admission into the ChE PhD program.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Chemical Engineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: CCNY's Chemical Engineering admissions page specifies TOEFL iBT 79-80 (4.5 updated scale), PTE 53, or Duolingo 100 (an older department page lists 73 iBT).
toefl_min.quote: Minimum Language Test Scores: 79-80 (TOEFL IBT), 4.5 (TOEFL updated scale), 6.5 (IELTS), 53 (PTE) or 100 (Duolingo)

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic band score is 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum Language Test Scores: 79-80 (TOEFL IBT), 4.5 (TOEFL updated scale), 6.5 (IELTS), 53 (PTE) or 100 (Duolingo)

supervisor.value: Applicants are admitted to the department as a whole and choose a field of study or professor's group in their first term.
supervisor.quote: No, applicants are admitted to the Chemical Engineering Department as a whole. A prospective student must first apply to the program, be accepted, then in their first term in the program, choose a particular field of study or professor's group.

funding.value: Five-year CCNY/GSOE fellowships ($41,331 annual stipend, health benefits, and full tuition) are available on a competitive basis alongside outside funding.
funding.quote: The program provides a 5-year CCNY Fellowship which includes a $41,331 stipend per year, health benefits, and full tuition for in-state and out-of-state residents. In addition, outside funding is available. The programs are prestigious and highly competitive.

entry_route.value: Open to applicants holding an accredited bachelor's degree (or foreign equivalent); up to 30 graduate transfer credits may be accepted from prior master's study.
entry_route.quote: Graduate study is open to qualified students who possess a bachelor’s degree from an accredited U.S. college or university or the equivalent from a foreign institution and an adequate background in the field of study that they wish to pursue.

also.quote: The school allows a maximum of 30 transfer credits.

notes: 61 total credits required. Admissions summary page lists 79-80 TOEFL iBT while the ChE PhD department page lists 73 iBT.
name: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering
